resources.string: Hidden library, separate categories and local-only protection
Replace the local PIN used by Private favourites
Clear the current in-memory unlock session immediately
Off by default. Enable only when you explicitly want private categories and memberships in local backups.
Private category names and memberships will be stored inside local backup files. The PIN and security method are never included.
Restore Private categories and memberships separately from Normal. Off by default for every restore.
Choose how the hidden library is unlocked
Biometric or device credential authentication is not available on this device.
Private favourites will still be hidden from normal navigation, but opening them will no longer require authentication.
Permanently remove all Private protection and move the Private collection to Normal Favourites. Afterward, app-wide features treat it the same as Normal Favourites.

This permanently removes all Private protection. Choose whether to keep the collection in Private without isolation or move it back to Normal Favourites. The Private PIN, biometric requirement, backup privacy option and screenshot restriction will be cleared. Manga files, chapters, downloads and reading history will not be deleted.
All Private security has been disabled. The collection remains in Private without isolation.
All Private security has been disabled and the collection has been moved to Normal Favourites.
All Private Favourites security has been disabled and the collection has been moved to Normal Favourites.
